rounds.text: Ashwini Container Movers Ltd carries significant balance sheet and operational risks that warrant caution despite recent profitability metrics. Debt to equity stands at an alarming 2.50x as of September 2025, with total borrowings climbing to Rs 75 Cr from Rs 63 Cr a year earlier [E26, E27]. This high leverage means debt exceeds the company's net worth, introducing substantial financial risk [E26]. Operational execution is also showing friction, evidenced by debtor days increasing from 90.4 to 109 days [E39] and quarterly operating margins turning inconsistent over the last two quarters [E21]. Furthermore, domestic institutional investors have reduced their stake significantly, dropping from 9.37% in December 2025 to 5.95% by June 2026 [E31], and the dividend yield sits at 0.00% [E3]. Conceded: the company demonstrates strong multi-year sales growth [E43], high return on equity [E44], and positive institutional money flow driven by foreign holdings [E32].
